set.question: It is 11 p.m. Which greeting fits best?

why: At 8 p.m. in Spain, Buenas tardes is still used; 11 p.m. unambiguously selects Buenas noches.
Pin Hola as a greeting (adiós and gracias also work any time of day).
Fix length-giveaway (13 vs 8 chars) with full English sentences of comparable length.

set.question: How do you ask someone "Where are you from?"

why: Quote the direct question instead of reported speech (fixes reported-question suspect).
